title: AI Blog Writer with RAG
description: Chunked RAG with default TF-IDF; `retrieval: pinecone` or `chroma` enables OpenAI dense embeddings and vector storage. Pinecone requires a provisioned 1536-dimensional cosine vector index and PINECONE_INDEX_HOST. Keys required. Token streaming remains an extension.
